_meta.schema: Each feature: id, area, title, behavior, status, verification, evidence, notes
_meta.rule: Status only moves to 'passing' when verification command exits 0 and output matches expected. Agent cannot self-declare passing.

features.title: JWT auth (access + refresh tokens)
features.behavior: POST /auth/credentials and POST /auth/telegram/miniapp return { accessToken, refreshToken, user }. POST /auth/refresh renews access token.
features.evidence: Implemented in src/auth/. TypeScript clean as of 2026-05-21.

features.title: Wallet debit/credit with immutable ledger
features.behavior: Every wallet mutation via WalletService creates a LedgerEntry in the same TypeORM transaction (EntityManager). No direct wallet row writes anywhere.
features.evidence: src/wallet/, src/ledger/. Idempotency keys enforced. TypeORM EntityManager pattern.

features.title: Keno draw lifecycle (open → locked → drawn → settled)
features.behavior: Scheduler auto-creates draws. RNG draws 20 unique numbers 1–80. All tickets settled atomically. Bot tickets auto-bought.
features.evidence: src/keno/, src/scheduler/keno.scheduler.ts. Admin can trigger manually.

features.title: PATCH /keno/tickets/:id/numbers — post-purchase number edit
features.behavior: Player can update selected numbers on a pending ticket while draw is still open. Spot count must stay the same. Draw status re-validated.

features.title: Bingo room lifecycle (open → running → completed) with multiple win modes
features.behavior: Rooms auto-advance. Scheduler draws 1 ball per drawIntervalSeconds from a numberRange pool. winMode ∈ {line (90-ball, one/two/full tiers), pattern (5×5 patternPrizes), prefilled/derash (cartela grid)}. Self-healing guard settles remaining tiers and completes stuck rooms.
features.evidence: src/bingo/. Configurable: salesWindowSeconds, drawIntervalSeconds, resultDisplaySeconds, houseEdgePct. See .harness/topics/bingo-reveal.md.

features.title: Prefilled / derash mode with cartela cards and DB-backed patterns
features.behavior: winMode='prefilled' (default). gridSize (default 75) cartela cards pre-generated into the BingoCard pool. Purchase DTO accepts cartelaNumbers[]; BingoTicket.cartelaNumber records the pick. Winning patterns are DB config (seed:bingo-patterns). Derash settlement splits pot by houseEdgePct and records winner's last-4 phone digits.

features.title: One-active-game guard (DB UNIQUE index)
features.behavior: BingoRoom.activeGuard is a nullable tinyint under UNIQUE index UQ_bingo_active_game — set to 1 while open/running, NULL on completion. Prevents two concurrent creators (even across instances or with Redis lock down) from opening two active rooms; second INSERT fails with duplicate-key error.

features.title: GET /bingo/current — priority room for player
features.behavior: Returns running room first, then open room, then last completed room (with user tickets). No room lobby required.

features.title: Crash game round lifecycle (waiting → running → crashed)
features.behavior: JWT-guarded endpoints. RNG generates crash point. Bets auto-cashout. Stale rounds abandoned on bootstrap with bet refunds.
features.evidence: src/crash/. JwtModule added. abandonStaleRounds() called on bootstrap.

features.title: Socket.IO live counts (heartbeat + on-demand)
features.behavior: Gateway broadcasts live.counts every 10s. Client can emit request.counts to pull immediately. Counts cover all game rooms.

features.title: Admin REST API (config, agents, stats, draws)
features.behavior: Admins can manage Keno/Bingo/Crash config, create agents, view stats, trigger draws, process withdrawals.

features.title: Telebirr deposit receipt ingestion
features.behavior: POST /payments/telebirr/callback validates receipt and credits wallet. Idempotent.

features.title: RNG service with audit logging
features.behavior: All game draws use RngService, never Math.random(). Audit log records algorithm version, inputs, outputs, hash, timestamp.

features.behavior: initData validated server-side with bot token. User linked to internal iGames account. Bot is optional — backend works without it.

features.title: Bingo paced ball reveal (shared cursor)
features.behavior: A single revealedCount cursor paces balls one at a time (~1.5s each, min 0.65s when far behind) so caller, board and all cards advance together even when a 5s poll delivers a batch. Snaps to full on room switch and completion; clamps overshoot; reveal sound synced to cursor tick; cards mark from revealedSet not raw drawnNumbers.

features.title: Admin Telegram broadcast (send-now / scheduled / recurring)
features.behavior: Admin composes text + optional uploaded image + inline URL buttons and sends to all Telegram-linked users. scheduleType ∈ {now, once (scheduledAtLocal), recurring (daily|weekly, HH:mm, Ethiopia +180min)}. Multer upload to uploads/broadcasts (served /uploads/**). TelegramBotService.sendBroadcastMessage throttles ~25 msg/s, honours 429 retry_after, skips blocked users, reuses the photo file_id after the first send. BroadcastScheduler (@Cron 30s, Redis-locked) claims due rows with an atomic scheduled->sending status guard; background dispatch; 45-min stale recovery.
features.evidence: src/broadcast/, src/telegram/telegram-bot.service.ts, src/scheduler/broadcast.scheduler.ts. Commits 19baa9b, 2848de1. See DECISIONS D-16.
features.notes: Deploy needs writable uploads/ dir + npm install (@types/multer). Live blast not exercised.

features.title: Durable per-user notifications (bell) + socket push
features.behavior: notifications table + NotificationsService.create() persists then emits notification.new on the user_{id} socket room. GET /notifications returns {items, unreadCount}; POST /notifications/read marks read. safeCreate() is called post-commit best-effort from: withdrawal settle (admin + both agent paths), deposit credit (new credits only), admin adjustment, and bingo/keno win at settlement (notifyRoomWinners/notifyDrawWinners, aggregated per user, bot accounts skipped).
features.evidence: src/notifications/, gateway.emitUserNotification, wallet/payments/admin/bingo/keno hooks. Commits 405d50f, 3c49b64. See DECISIONS D-15.
features.notes: Crash wins not yet wired (crash.bet.cashedout already targets user_{id}).

features.title: OptionalJwtAuthGuard on Bingo read endpoints
features.behavior: Reusable guard extends JwtAuthGuard; populates request.user when a valid Bearer token is present, allows anonymous otherwise (never rejects). Applied to GET /bingo/current, /bingo/rooms/:id/state, /bingo/rooms/:id/sync so a logged-in player's own tickets are returned by the server (fixes cartelas vanishing on tab switch/reload) without blocking spectators.
features.evidence: src/auth/guards/optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts (+ .spec, 4 cases), src/bingo/bingo.controller.ts. Commit 2272c8b. See DECISIONS D-14.
features.notes: Guard that extends another must declare an explicit constructor (DI metadata).

features.title: Server-backed notification bell
features.behavior: NotificationBell loads GET /notifications on login (survives reload, shows what was missed), listens for notification.new over the socket, persists read state via POST /notifications/read on open, and renders per-type icons (win/deposit/withdrawal/adjustment/bonus). Store gained setNotifications + addServerNotification (dedupe by id). Dead *.ticket.won listeners removed.

features.title: MySQL table row format migration
features.behavior: All 25 tables use ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC to avoid 8126-byte InnoDB inline limit.
features.verification: SELECT TABLE_NAME, ROW_FORMAT FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND ROW_FORMAT != 'Dynamic';
features.evidence: Entities now declare engine 'InnoDB ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC' (commit e608f21), so fresh schemas are correct. Existing production tables still need the ALTER.
features.notes: Run the 25 ALTER TABLE statements from session 2026-06-29 on any pre-existing production DB.
